scenario.intent: process fulfillment on stripe async payment success

command.$interpolate: capcli bind webhook stripe_hook stripe payment_succeeded {{routine_urp}} --ingress https://ops.example.com/hook -m "{{intent}}"
command.$example: capcli bind webhook stripe_hook stripe payment_succeeded cap://sync_orders --ingress https://ops.example.com/hook -m "process fulfillment on stripe async payment success"

culprit.$example: Unsigned hooks rejected. HMAC-SHA256 verification must be armed at bind time.

component.remedy: Inject the provider signing secret out-of-band — `capcli sys vault set stripe_webhook_secret --in @-` (stdin, never argv) in the operator shell, `CAPCLI_SECRET_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in the harness env, or external client RPC — then re-run bind webhook. Verification arms against the opaque vault://stripe_webhook_secret handle; plaintext never enters agent context.
